camel_example: aliyun polardbx CreateDB --region cn-hangzhou --Charset utf8mb4 --DbName testdb --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceName 'pxc-00000000000000' --AccountName testaccount
description_en: Creates a database by calling the CreateDB operation
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-db --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000000000 --account-name testaccount --charset utf8mb4 --db-name testdb --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDB

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the account that is authorized to access the created database
parameters.help_zh: 创建的数据库授权的指定账号名称
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The character set. The following character sets are supported:

utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.help_zh:
字符集，支持如下字符集：

utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.name: charset

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to create
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions granted to the account on the new database. Valid values:

ReadWrite
ReadOnly
DMLOnly
DDLOnly
parameters.help_zh:
给新创建的账号授权某数据库的权限，包括：

ReadWrite
ReadOnly
DMLOnly
DDLOnly
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en:
The name of the security administrator account.

If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh:
安全管理员账号名称。

若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填
parameters.name: security_account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the security administrator account.

If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh:
安全管理员账号密码。

若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填
parameters.name: security_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The mode selected when creating the database. Valid values:

auto: The database supports automatic partitioning. You do not need to specify a partition key when creating a table.
drds: The database does not support automatic partitioning. You must use dedicated table and database sharding syntax and specify sharding keys when creating a table
parameters.help_zh:
创建数据库时选择的模式，取值如下：

auto：该模式的数据库支持自动分区，即创建表时无需指定分区键；
drds：该模式的数据库不支持自动分区，创建表时需使用专用的分库分表语法，指定分库分表键
parameters.name: mode

Message.description_en: Empty if the request is successful. An error message is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 成功为空，失败返回错误信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
